title: Steampunk Lunar Oracle
description: A surreal circular painting features a large metallic mechanical face constructed from rusted copper, purple, and gold panels with visible gears, rivets, and bolts. The face has a human-like nose, mouth with teeth, and closed mechanical eyes, set against a desert landscape with sand dunes, a large full moon, a smaller crescent moon, and a glowing orange prohibition symbol on the left.
prompt: Surreal oval composition of a large steampunk mechanical head made of riveted rusted copper, purple, and brass panels with exposed gears and bolts. The face has a realistic nose, open mouth showing teeth, and closed mechanical eyelids. Floating in a night desert with sand dunes, a giant full moon in the cloudy sky, a small crescent moon, and an orange glowing prohibition symbol on the left side, dramatic cinematic lighting, painterly texture.
